name: polairity
description: Write private Polairity signal entries from high-level tool assessments.

interface.longDescription: Turn a user's high-level AI tool assessment into a private Polairity signal entry. The plugin prepares a catalog-backed form, can show compact prior ratings, asks only for confirmed signal fields, never publishes publicly, and never uploads private code, prompts, or logs.
defaultPrompt: Use @polairity to save a private signal entry for this AI tool experience
